faqs.q: Sec. 86-35. - Application to retirees and former employees.
faqs.a:
Present retirees of the former pension fund shall be entitled to a review by the board
               of trustees. The benefits to be received shall not exceed the benefits of this chapter.
               The retirees referred to are the widow of Sgt. Leon McKinnon, Leonard Smith and the
               two children of Robert Beghtol. All persons who have terminated prior to the effective
               date of this chapter for any reason whatsoever shall not be entitled to any interest,
               benefits or provisions of this chapter whatsoever, it being the express intent of
               this chapter that the provisions herein are to apply from the effective date of this
               chapter forward and shall not give rise to any rights, obligations or duties for persons
               that may have contributed to a police pension fund, but have now terminated their
               employment, for whatever reason, with the city.
(Code 1960, § 19-23; Code 1981, § 26-5)
